sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Wind Release

system.description:
The ground erupts outward from you covering a 30-foot cube, originating from you, across the ground freezing the feet of creatures in range. Creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, having their movement speed reduced by 20 feet and gaining a rank of Frostbite on a failed save. Creatures captured in this jutsu can make strength saving throw as an action on their turn to escape this jutsu.

The area this jutsu affects leaves behind ice-covered ground being treated as difficult terrain for the duration. Creatures who enter this area of this jutsu must make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling Prone.

If this jutsu is cast while occupying an Ice Mirror, you can select up to 3 spaces you can see within range, and conjure a Ice Mirrors. At the end of the current turn, dispel all Ice Mirrors beyond your current limit of what you can maintain.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the cube by +10 feet.
